newsitem.title: USA: SDL says CFO G. Lindholm to leave company.
newsitem.headline: SDL says CFO G. Lindholm to leave company.

text.p: SDL Inc said Monday chief executive officer Gregory Lindholm is leaving the company, and executive vice president John Melton will replace him on an interim basis.
The company also said Melton has taken on the management of its finance department effective immediately.
The company said Lindhold is leaving the company to pursue other interests in the San Diego area.
The company said it is beginning a formal search to identify a permanent CFO.
